position_overview: Online Hotel Reservationist (Remote Opportunity) Location: Remote | Work From Home About the Role: Do you love travel and helping others plan unforgettable getaways? Were looking for motivated individuals to join our growing team as Online Hotel Reservationists . In this role, youll assist clients with hotel and resort bookings, coordinate accommodations for vacations and business trips, and provide excellent customer serviceall from the comfort of your home. What Youll Do: Research and book hotels, resorts, and vacation accommodations worldwide Provide professional guidance and personalized travel recommendations Communicate with clients via phone, email, or online platforms Manage reservations, special requests, and travel details accurately Stay up to date on promotions, travel deals, and supplier policies Deliver a seamless and enjoyable booking experience for every traveler What We Provide: Full training and certificationno experience required Access to a personal booking website and hundreds of top suppliers Daily live trainings and ongoing support from experienced mentors Exclusive travel perks and discounted rates Flexible hours (part-time or full-time options available) Opportunity to grow into a Certified Travel Specialist Qualifications: Passion for travel and hospitality Excellent communication and customer service skills Self-motivated with attention to detail Comfortable using computers, email, and online tools Must be 18 years or older Why Join Us: As part of our travel family, youll enjoy the freedom to work remotely, set your own schedule, and turn your passion for travel into a rewarding business.
